entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf animist of the Joraga tribe on Zendikar who bonds with the soul of the land, faces the dark knot at Akoum, and has her spark ignite, sending her to Lorwyn.

entities.name: Mazik
entities.description: Nissa's loyal elf friend who believes in the animist ways and travels with her to the mountain.

entities.name: Numa
entities.description: The Chief of the Joraga who sends Nissa and her mother away to protect his tribe.

entities.name: Meroe
entities.description: Nissa's mother, one of the last animists, who believes Nissa's visions are a gift.

entities.name: Dwynen
entities.description: An elf leader of the blight hunt on Lorwyn who turns on Nissa and is caught by the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Galed
entities.description: A Lorwyn elf hunter who flirts with Nissa and kills boggarts.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, whose living soul appears to her as a stream of glowing light and is in pain from the dark knot.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The somber plane Nissa lands on after her first planeswalk, where the Great Aurora brings Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The wave of twisted night that sweeps Lorwyn, changing those it touches.

entities.name: The Joraga
entities.description: The elf tribe of Zendikar's forest to which Nissa belongs, led by Numa.

entities.name: The animists
entities.description: A people who angered Zendikar; Nissa and her mother are among the last.

entities.name: The dark knot
entities.description: The writhing darkness inside the highest peak of Akoum that hurts Zendikar and Nissa sees in her visions.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's violent reaction to the dark knot, causing land to churn and rain rocks.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The mountain region of Zendikar where the dark knot lies beneath its highest peak.

entities.name: Joraga forest
entities.description: The forest on Zendikar where Nissa's tribe lives.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Blood-streaked vampires that hunt Nissa and Mazik in the bog.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Small warty creatures of Lorwyn that the elves call a blight and that Nissa sees as innocent.

entities.name: Nissa's elemental
entities.description: An elemental that Zendikar forms from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the peak.

events.summary: Nissa wakes from a vision of a black knot choking a stream of living light, in her bed at home.
events.quote: Nissa awoke with a start, screaming and gasping for breath.

events.summary: Nissa overhears Numa tell her mother he must send them away because of her visions.
events.quote: "I have no choice, Meroe. I cannot risk Zendikar's retribution. I'm sorry. Truly, I am."

events.summary: Nissa slips away from camp at night, hiding her trail so the horror will find only her.
events.quote: she would not lead the horror to those she loved.

events.summary: A shimmering stream like the one in her vision appears and wraps around Nissa like a cocoon; she connects with Zendikar's soul.
events.quote: Nissa Revane connected with Zendikar.

events.summary: Nissa's vision shows a glowing version of herself facing the dark knot in a mountain before a bright light consumes all.
events.quote: a bright light blasted through the whole vision

events.summary: Mazik finds Nissa and reveals he followed her with her mother's knowledge; Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.
events.quote: Zendikar isn't after me.

events.summary: Nissa and Mazik follow the stream out of the forest and across the canyons, running short of water.
events.quote: Together, they followed the stream of glowing light deeper into the forest.

events.summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
events.quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

events.summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
events.quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

events.summary: Nissa practices her new powers while crossing the foothills of Akoum.
events.quote: Mazik encouraged Nissa to practice using her new powers.

events.summary: The glowing stream vanishes and the Roil strikes, shaking the land violently.
events.quote: "The Roil! It's happening!"

events.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
events.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

events.summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
events.quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

events.summary: At the ring of floating hedrons around the highest peak, Mazik falls ill and Nissa must go on alone.
events.quote: "I want you to go. I'll be okay. We'll be okay."

events.summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
events.quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

events.summary: The dark knot's madness shows Nissa the monster inside, and her spark ignites, hurling her from Zendikar.
events.quote: something inside her cracked, like an egg breaking open

events.summary: Nissa lands on Lorwyn and sees the coming blight in a vision.
events.quote: Lorwyn, it called itself.

events.summary: Nissa is found by the elves of the blight hunt led by Dwynen and joins the hunt.
events.quote: Take up your blade and prove yourself.

events.summary: Galed kills boggarts despite Nissa's pleas, and Nissa feels one die.
events.quote: And then she felt it die.

events.summary: Nissa turns her blade on Galed and Dwynen turns on her, just as Shadowmoor arrives.
events.quote: How dare you come to my forest and tell me what I can do?

events.summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
events.quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
events.quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

relations.quote: This was Numa, Chief of the Joraga.

relations.note: Friend who follows and supports her.
relations.quote: We believe your visions are important.

relations.note: Lives in the Joraga camp until sent away.
relations.quote: Numa was going to kick them out of the Joraga camp.

relations.note: She and her mother are the last of them.
relations.quote: She was a danger, the last of the animists

relations.note: She faces and fails to destroy it.
relations.quote: She hated it for what it had done to Zendikar

relations.note: Blames Nissa for the destruction and aims an arrow at her.
Kills boggarts he calls a blight.
Kills the vampires' leader and others with her elemental.
relations.quote: It took the first two out merely by crashing into them.

relations.note: Formed by Zendikar and under her control.
relations.quote: the elemental was under her control
